title: Nell and the Windy Day
note: b415 — Phase 5 (School readiness) — new sounds 'ay', 'ou' and 'ie'.

pages.brief: Leaves streaming sideways across the garden on a bright windy day.
Nell the bee setting off across the garden towards Pip's tree.
Nell the bee flying high above the hedge, wings working hard.
Nell the bee being blown sideways off course by a gust of wind.
Nell the bee tumbling slightly in the air, unable to fly straight.
Nell the bee flying low, just above the grass, out of the worst of the wind.
Nell the bee flying steadily along close to the grass.
Nell the bee landing on the branch beside Pip the sparrow.
Pip the sparrow and Nell the bee playing together on a low branch.
Pip the sparrow and Nell the bee playing together in a sheltered spot beneath the hedge.
